notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Unsubscribe Object Class Directed Interactions service-report implementation to both official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab for §5.13. The focused real-filesystem regression verifies rejected undefined object or interaction class inputs append no successful-void record; the interaction-set overload emits ObjectClassHandle type 36 plus a supplied InteractionClassHandleSet type 28 (including []); and the whole-class overload preserves the optional set as type-34 Null. It does not prove complete directed unsubscription/delivery, generic return/failure forms, public MOM publication, timestamped behavior, DDM, remote transport, JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.
